design: Post-hoc descriptive audit of the already frozen v2 classifier, after v2 test metrics were inspected. No retraining, prompt/model selection, semantic label remapping or new test-performance claim.
label_normalization: Remove whitespace and one terminal 证 only; no inferred clinical synonym equivalence.
input: Same three TCM-SD fields and 4096-character limit as v2. TCMEval only Clinical Data. No label or reasoning input.
outputs: Per-label test precision/recall/F1 with training frequency
Known-label upper bound and conditional top1/top3 on TCMEval
Character 2/3-gram vocabulary coverage and input length summaries by dataset
privacy: Aggregates and syndrome label names only; no narratives or user identifiers in Git. Source and model checksums verified against v2.
